title: Global Intelligence Monitor
summary: A one-page briefing on world news, conflicts, politics and the economy in the week to 6 November 2026, with country profiles and a timeline since 1945.

news.headline: Trump warns US may have to 'destroy the rest' of Iran; decision 'soon'
news.summary: Anadolu Agency / Al Jazeera: In the Oval Office on 5 Nov (reported 6 Nov), Trump said he may have to 'destroy the rest' of Iran and that 'you'll know soon enough', while claiming he would rather not. He also said Iran is 'not doing anything without our approval' when asked about mediator nuclear proposals. Claim — no new strike announced.

news.headline: Iran sends nuclear proposal to US via Qatar; seven preconditions claimed
news.summary: Reuters (via Iran International / Arab News): A senior Iranian official said Tehran sent a nuclear proposal through Qatar but will discuss it only after Washington meets seven demands (sanctions relief, frozen assets, maritime issues among claims). The US is reviewing the offer; details not published.

news.headline: Alliana assumes Paraguay presidency after Peña resigns and is impeached
news.summary: AS/COA / NPR: Santiago Peña resigned on 5 Nov over the Ueno Bank collapse; the lower house then impeached him unanimously. Vice-President Pedro Alliana was spared a parallel impeachment and assumed the presidency; he must manage the bank fallout through August 2028.

news.headline: South Africa local count: ANC 31.8%, DA 24.9% with ~71% counted
news.summary: The Outlier (IEC data): With about 71% of voting districts counted, ANC leads the national PR ballot on 31.8%, DA 24.9%, MK 8.9%. Of 104 local councils decided, ANC won 21 outright, DA 6, MK 3, with 73 hung. Full results still expected around 8 Nov.

news.headline: New Zealand election eve: Opportunity party cast as kingmaker
news.summary: The Guardian / AP: Final polls ahead of the 7 Nov vote show National and Labour both near ~29–30%; neither right nor left bloc is projected to govern alone. Centrist Opportunity (led by Qiulae Wong) may clear 5% and hold the balance; Luxon has repeatedly ruled out working with it.

news.headline: Putin hosts Iran's Rezaei at the Kremlin on security and postwar arrangements
news.summary: Kremlin / Anadolu: On 5 Nov Putin received Supreme National Security Council secretary Mohsen Rezaei, who conveyed a message from Iran's leadership. Talks covered regional security, postwar arrangements and a proposed Russia–Iran gas pipeline (official readout).

news.headline: Massie plans Hegseth impeachment House vote as Congress returns
news.summary: USA Today / WCAX / Roll Call: Rep. Thomas Massie says he will force a House vote on articles of impeachment against Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth when Congress returns (around 9 Nov). Hegseth vowed to fight; Trump still says he is 'doing a very good job'. Removal would still need a two-thirds Senate vote.

news.headline: Brent holds near $98.29 Friday as Hormuz risks offset peace hopes
news.summary: Gulf News / CNBC: Brent futures around $98.29 early Friday (Beijing time quote); WTI near $91.07. Thursday settle was Brent $98.29 (+$3.67) and WTI $90.52 after Hormuz tanker incidents. Eurasia Group cut odds of a deal to 10% and of renewed US strikes to 60%.

news.headline: UNHCR: nearly 90 million displaced people face severe climate risks
news.summary: France 24 / Reuters: UNHCR said on Friday nearly 90 million forcibly displaced people — about three-quarters of the global total — live in countries highly exposed to droughts, floods and extreme heat, urging more adaptation finance ahead of COP31 in Antalya. Only about 10% of climate finance reaches fragile or conflict-affected countries (claim based on UNHCR).

news.headline: Trump says Ukraine war 'very close' to a deal after meeting Putin's envoy
news.summary: DW / AP / Reuters: After a private White House meeting with Kirill Dmitriev (not the Ukrainian delegation), Trump told reporters a 'big, beautiful' agreement is near that 'might involve all of Europe'. He gave no terms; Kushner called Brussels reconstruction/security talks 'productive' ahead of Abu Dhabi 10–11 Nov.

news.headline: Russell Brand convicted of rape and three sexual assaults
news.summary: BBC: A Southwark Crown Court jury found the comedian guilty of one count of rape and three sexual assaults (not guilty on other counts). He was remanded in custody; sentencing is due Monday 9 Nov, with the judge saying to expect a 'significant custodial term'. Met Police say further allegations remain under investigation.

news.headline: Senate Democrats prepare JPMorgan probe over Epstein banking ties
news.summary: CNBC: Democratic staff on the Senate Finance Committee (expected chair Ron Wyden) plan to use subpoena power once they take the majority to examine how JPMorgan handled Jeffrey Epstein, focusing on decisions by asset-and-wealth CEO Mary Erdoes. JPMorgan declined to comment; it has previously said it regrets any association.

news.headline: British Ebola patient arrives at London's Royal Free Hospital
news.summary: Guardian / Reuters: A UK doctor who tested positive while helping the DR Congo outbreak was evacuated and admitted to a specialist isolation unit; authorities say public risk remains low. It is the first British national linked to the current outbreak.

news.headline: Iran reports three more Hormuz tankers damaged after US midterms
news.summary: Reuters: Iran said two tankers struck naval mines and another caught fire on 5 Nov; UKMTO still cites ≥5 vessel incidents since Sunday. Parliament Speaker Qalibaf mocked VP Vance over blaming the Iran war for Republican losses. Qatari mediation continues; no breakthrough announced.

news.headline: North Korea tests new air-defence missile and cruise-missile drill
news.summary: Yonhap/KCNA: Pyongyang said it test-fired a newly designed air-defence missile system on 4 Nov and staged a long-range strategic cruise-missile strike drill against a virtual airport target — its fourth weapons test in a week. South Korea's JCS detected multiple missiles from Sondok flying less than 300 km.

news.headline: Democrats prepare energy and Iran-war probes for January Congress
news.summary: CNBC: With House and Senate control, Democrats plan subpoenas on Trump energy deal-making — Venezuela oil (NABEP), critical-minerals stakes, cancelled renewables — and a war-powers push to end the Iran war. Jeffries said Democrats will 'end this reckless and costly war of choice'.

news.headline: Europe flight hoaxes: emails signed 'fighters of the Male State'
news.summary: Straits Times/AFP: Threat emails to Rome and Sofia airports during the 5 Nov wave of hoax bomb alerts were signed 'the fighters of the Male State'. AFP could not confirm a link to the far-right Russian movement of that name. At least 25–27 flights were disrupted across Europe.

news.headline: France protests revised to 575,000; Lecornu sets Monday social conference
news.summary: France 24: Interior ministry revised Thursday turnout to 575,000 (from ~600,000); CGT still claims nearly 1.6 million. About 448 arrests and 53 injured officers (provisional). PM Sébastien Lecornu will hold a social conference with unions and employers on Monday 9 Nov.

news.headline: Nigerian court voids Atiku's presidential candidacy
news.summary: A Federal High Court in Abuja nullified the David Mark-led leadership of the opposition ADC and all its actions, including Atiku Abubakar's nomination for the 16 January 2027 presidential election. The ADC and Atiku say they will appeal and seek a stay of execution; Atiku calls the timing politically motivated (claim).

news.headline: Nvidia and Qualcomm drop over 9% in post-election chip sell-off
news.summary: CNBC says the Nasdaq fell 5.5%, its worst day since April 2025, as investors priced in a slower AI data-centre buildout after the Democratic sweep; Nvidia lost almost $450bn in market value, AMD, Micron and Applied Materials fell by double digits, and Tesla and SpaceX each dropped more than 9%.

news.headline: Fed's Barkin expects further, gradual rate hikes
news.summary: Richmond Fed President Thomas Barkin said inflation is 'the most important risk' and the Fed will have to raise rates further at a gradual pace. CME FedWatch shows markets pricing a better than 80% chance of a December hike.

news.headline: Newsom to commute all 548 California death sentences
news.summary: California Governor Gavin Newsom said he will change every death sentence in the state to life without parole before leaving office. California Supreme Court approval is needed for people convicted of more than one felony.

news.headline: Nithya Raman ousts Karen Bass as Los Angeles mayor
news.summary: Democratic socialist councilmember Nithya Raman, once seen as a long shot, beat the incumbent mayor Karen Bass.

news.headline: Eight killed in a series of shootings in western Turkey
news.summary: Eight people were killed and one seriously injured at several locations in Afyonkarahisar province. Authorities say the suspect fled and was later arrested in Eskişehir province.

news.headline: Myanmar junta intensifies airstrikes in Rakhine
news.summary: France 24 Observers says strikes on 1 Nov killed 12 civilians and injured 32 in Rakhine State, including at a makeshift maternity clinic in Mrauk-U. This is part of the junta's offensive since September to retake the state, which is about 90% held by the Arakan Army. ACLED reports more use of double-tap strikes.

news.headline: Herzog to name who forms Israel's government on Sunday
news.summary: After finishing party consultations, President Herzog said he will announce on Sunday 8 Nov whom he tasks with forming a government. Eisenkot has 67 Knesset recommendations vs Netanyahu's 46; Herzog cited mutual vetoes and will hold private talks with party leaders over the Israeli weekend.

news.headline: Sweden extends Schengen internal border checks citing Russia hybrid threats
news.summary: Government decision: targeted internal border controls from 12 Nov 2026 to 11 May 2027. Justice Minister Gunnar Strömmer (via Reuters) linked the move to sabotage and hybrid threats tied to Russia's war on Ukraine; Kremlin denies the accusations.

news.headline: Italy finalising 13th military aid package for Ukraine
news.summary: Reuters: Defence Minister Guido Crosetto will brief COPASIR on 10 Nov on Italy's first 2026 arms tranche (13th overall). Package may include Aster interceptors for SAMP/T; Crosetto also proposes extending the decree-based aid mechanism beyond 31 Dec 2026 despite League opposition.

news.headline: Russia and Ukraine trade airstrikes as Brussels reconstruction talks resume
news.summary: AP: overnight Russian barrage and Ukrainian drone strikes continued as talks on postwar reconstruction and security guarantees resumed in Brussels. Search continues at Komyshuvakha after Monday's aid-point strike.

news.headline: Burnham: Putin will not be invited to Britain's G20 summit
news.summary: Reuters via Devdiscourse: UK PM Andy Burnham told The Economist that Russian President Vladimir Putin would not be invited to next year's G20 summit in Britain.

news.headline: Putin puts Japan Tobacco's Russian assets under temporary state management
news.summary: A presidential decree transfers JTI stakes in four Russian factories (about 4,000 staff and roughly 40% of the cigarette market) to Industrial Assets / Promyshlennye Aktivy. JTI said it is assessing options; the move follows earlier seizures of Nestlé, Auchan, Metro and others.

news.headline: South Korea plans to expand anti-piracy mission closer to Hormuz
news.summary: Seoul will seek Assembly approval to extend the Cheonghae unit from the Gulf of Aden to waters south of Oman (~1,930 km radius), add a P-8A patrol aircraft and an EOD/mine team, and keep operations non-combat and outside the strait itself.

news.headline: Poland detains six over military-parts smuggling to Russia
news.summary: ABW and prosecutors say five Poles and a Russian woman ran a group that moved ammunition and weapons components to Kaliningrad (worth over 2 million zloty). Four face espionage charges and pretrial detention; the group operated at least June 2023–December 2025.

news.headline: Meloni urges EU to appoint a single Ukraine peace envoy
news.summary: In a letter to European Council President António Costa, Italy's PM said overlapping Miami, Oslo, Brussels and other formats make Europe look 'all over the place' and asked for the issue to go on the 13 Nov Dublin informal summit agenda, with a formal decision by December.

news.headline: Nasdaq closes down 5.17% as AI and chip stocks plunge
news.summary: Investing.com historical data put the Nasdaq Composite close at 24,405.73 (−5.17%). Afternoon reporting had the S&P 500 off about 3.7% and the Dow about 2.8–2.9% as chipmakers and data-centre names led a post-midterm AI sell-off.

news.headline: Bank of England raises rates to 4%, first hike in over three years
news.summary: The MPC voted 8-1 to lift Bank Rate from 3.75% to 4% (Catherine Mann wanted 4.25%), citing energy prices from the Iran war, and now expects UK inflation near 5% by mid-2027.

news.headline: Eisenkot gets 67 recommendations to form Israel's next government
news.summary: Joint List and Ra'am joined other opposition parties so Eisenkot has 67 Knesset recommendations vs 46 for Netanyahu; UTJ recommended no one. Herzog is expected to grant him the mandate after consultations wrap (28 days, plus up to 14).

news.headline: Melania Trump hosts Russian and Ukrainian officials at the White House
news.summary: The first lady met representatives who arranged the six-day Oleshky ceasefire and called for a more 'enduring' peace, ahead of US-led trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi on 10-11 Nov.

news.headline: Komyshuvakha strike death toll rises to 43
news.summary: Kyiv Independent: 43 bodies recovered after Monday's Russian aerial-bomb attack on an aid point in Zaporizhzhia Oblast; about 33 people still missing. Zelensky called it proof Russia does not want de-escalation as US-hosted talks approach.

news.headline: Joshua Wong jailed for 10 years under Hong Kong security law
news.summary: The pro-democracy activist, due for release in January, was sentenced for colluding with foreign forces under the 2020 national security law.

news.headline: Sudan and Ethiopia expel each other's diplomats
news.summary: Ethiopia ordered six Sudanese diplomats out; Sudan accuses Ethiopia of backing the RSF, while Ethiopia accuses Sudan, Egypt and Eritrea of backing Tigray rebels. Both deny the claims.

news.headline: Developing-country debt hits a record $9.4tn
news.summary: The World Bank's International Debt Report says debt rose 5.5% last year, the fastest in four years, with the poorest countries paying the highest interest rates since the late 1980s.

news.headline: Democrats win control of both houses of the US Congress
news.summary: In the 3 November midterms, Democrats took the House and the Senate in a sharp rebuke of President Trump. Democracy Now reports at least 231 House seats and at least seven Senate pickups, with Mississippi and Alaska still too close to call.

news.headline: US to host Ukraine-Russia talks in Abu Dhabi on 10-11 November
news.summary: US envoy Steve Witkoff said the working-level talks will cover post-war security, de-escalation, humanitarian steps and ending the war. They are the first three-way talks since February.

news.headline: US strikes Iran's Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz
news.summary: US officials called the strikes limited and defensive, after Iranian forces fired on US assets. It was the first US attack on the island since June, while Qatari mediation continues.

news.headline: Drone attacks push Sudan's power grid toward collapse
news.summary: At least 15 substations have been hit since early October. The UN envoy says talks with the RSF and its allies are expected before Christmas.

news.headline: Prabowo sacks chief of staff over alleged wiretapping
news.summary: Indonesia's president dismissed Listyo Sigit Prabowo after he and two senior police officers were detained over alleged illegal wiretapping of the president and others.

conflicts.name: Russia-Ukraine war
conflicts.latest: Al Jazeera/AP: After meeting Kirill Dmitriev (5 Nov), Trump again claimed a major deal is 'very close' and could involve 'all of Europe' — no terms published (claim). Abu Dhabi US-mediated talks still set for 10–11 Nov (Witkoff/Kushner; Medinsky for Russia). Melania hosted RU/UA officials on the Oleshky humanitarian truce. Fighting continues; Komyshuvakha toll earlier reported at 43.

conflicts.name: US/Israel-Iran war
conflicts.latest: AA/Al Jazeera: Trump said he may have to 'destroy the rest' of Iran and that a decision is coming 'soon' (claim; no strike ordered). Reuters: Iran sent a nuclear proposal via Qatar with seven preconditions. Hormuz: Iran reported further tanker damage 5 Nov; UKMTO ≥5 incidents since Sunday. Putin hosted Iran's Rezaei in Moscow. Brent ~$98.29 Friday.

conflicts.name: Houthis vs Saudi-led coalition (Yemen)
conflicts.latest: Al Jazeera / Reuters: Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted a Houthi ballistic missile toward the Medina region (5 Nov). Houthis later claimed an attack on King Fahd airport in Dammam — no immediate Saudi confirmation. Saudi issued alerts for Yanbu Red Sea oil hub.

conflicts.name: Gaza
conflicts.parties: Israel, Hamas (Egypt, Qatar, Turkey, US mediating)
conflicts.latest: October 2025 ceasefire remains fragile. Democracy Now / Al Jazeera reported further Israeli gunfire killing Palestinians in Gaza on 5 Nov (claims; figures vary by source). Hamas still presses mediators in Cairo on next-phase implementation.

conflicts.name: Israel-Hezbollah (Lebanon)
conflicts.latest: Israeli shelling and a drone strike in southern Lebanon; Israel presses Beirut to keep Hezbollah out of any renewed Iran war.

conflicts.name: Sudan civil war
conflicts.parties: Sudanese Armed Forces, Rapid Support Forces
conflicts.latest: UN and AP warn drone strikes on power/fuel sites are deepening outages and hunger. Sudan and Ethiopia expelled each other's diplomats (Assosa/Qadaref) over alleged RSF backing. UN-backed talks with RSF bloc still expected before 25 Dec.
conflicts.source: AP / Al Jazeera / The Soufan Center

politics.detail: CNBC: subpoena power on Venezuela oil (NABEP), critical minerals and cancelled renewables; Jeffries pledges a war-powers push to end the Iran war.

politics.detail: ≥25 flights disrupted. AFP saw emails to Rome/Sofia signed 'fighters of the Male State' but could not confirm the Russian far-right group's involvement.

politics.detail: Opposition leaders back Gadi Eisenkot. The chosen candidate gets 28 days, extendable by 14; a new election is possible if talks fail.

politics.title: Bulgaria: President Iotova wins a new mandate
politics.detail: Official results gave her 57.58% in the runoff.

politics.title: Spain: cabinet reshuffle before snap election
politics.detail: Transport minister Oscar Puente resigned; Sanchez had called a general election for 29 November.

history.detail: BoE lifts Bank Rate to 4%; Peña resigns/impeached over Ueno Bank and Alliana is spared then assumes the presidency; ≥25–27 Europe flights hit by hoax bomb threats (Male State claim unverified); Nasdaq closes −5.17% / Brent settles $98.29; Herzog sets Sunday mandate decision; Melania hosts RU/UA at White House and Trump later claims a major Ukraine deal is near after meeting Dmitriev; Hegseth vows to fight impeachment (Massie aims for a House vote around 9 Nov); North Korea tests new air defence; Russell Brand convicted of rape and sexual assaults; Iranian tankers reported damaged in Hormuz; Putin hosts Iran's Rezaei. A Nigerian court voids Atiku's candidacy.
history.source: Al Jazeera / AA / Reuters / Euronews / CNBC / Outlier

history.title: Trump Iran threat; Alliana takes Paraguay; SA count advances; NZ election eve
history.detail: Trump says the US may have to 'destroy the rest' of Iran and that a decision is coming soon (claim). Iran's nuclear proposal via Qatar is under US review with seven Iranian preconditions claimed. Alliana assumes Paraguay's presidency; South Africa local count shows ANC ~31.8% / DA ~24.9% at ~71%; New Zealand votes 7 Nov in a cliffhanger with Opportunity as possible kingmaker.
history.source: Anadolu Agency / AS/COA / The Outlier / The Guardian
